name: Fonds francais pour l'environnement mondial (FFEM)
program: FFEM project financing (paused for new proposals until end 2026)
collect_note: FFEM is not accepting new proposals until the end of 2026 and its calls list is empty. No calls are collected. The calls list page is watched, and a new call appearing there is flagged for review.
evidence: Plain HTTP GET (desktop UA): ffem.fr/en/calls-for-projects/list 200, 4.6 KB text, 'No calls for projects found' (status filters Ongoing / Opening soon / Closed call); ffem.fr/en/frequently-asked-questions 200, pause statement present; ffem.fr/en/call-projects 200 (editorial, only the One Health call open until 30 April 2024); ffem.fr/rss.xml 200 (news and evaluation items, no calls); www.ffem.fr/feed and /wp-json/wp/v2/types 404 (site is Drupal). Checked 2026-11-12.
page_reason: FFEM has no open or upcoming call: its FAQ says it cannot receive new project proposals until the end of 2026, and its calls list view shows 'No calls for projects found' (the list renders server-side, so no card markup exists yet to build a list selector on). Calls are announced ad hoc after the 2027-2030 programming and the earlier ones (One Health, closed 30 April 2024) were one-off thematic calls.
